# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 6

- New MetroFuse logo and nine icon themes.
- The startup guide shows where to import plugins, sign in, and set audio source order.
- Galaxy and Galaxy Blur return as player backgrounds.
- Playback tries more than one eligible YouTube Music match after a source fails. Android can recover audio focus when you unlock during a playback interruption.

Install the Android APK over Beta 5. On Windows, extract the x64 ZIP and run the launcher.
